This mystical place had been shrouded in mystery for centuries, its existence known only to a select few. As the centuries passed, the civilization of Zenith began to decline, and the island was left to the mercy of the sea. The waves crashed against the shore, eroding the structures and leaving behind only ruins. But the energy of the island remained, a lingering presence that continued to shape the world around it.
